The '''National Statistics Institute of Guatemala''' ({{langx|es|Instituto Nacional de Estadística de Guatemala}}, INE) is the statistics agency of the [[Government of Guatemala]].  It has responsibility to collect, prepare, and publish official statistics.  INE runs the population census and issues statistics on employment, price levels, poverty rates, and other standard national statistics.<ref name=official>[http://www.ine.gob.gt Official site of INE]</ref>

INE will conduct a population census of Guatemala in July and August 2018, the twelfth such census.<ref>[https://www.ine.gob.gt/images/2018/Comunicaciones/Comunicado_Abre_la_puerta_al_Censo.pdf Abre la puerta al Censo] (Open the door to the Census). June, 2018.</ref>

INE publishes monthly consumer price index (CPI) statistics. Annual consumer price inflation was estimated at 4-5% in 2016.<ref>[https://www.centralamericadata.com/en/search?q1=content_en_le:%22National+Statistical+Institute+(Guatemala)%22&q2=mattersInCountry_es_le:%22Guatemala%22 News releases of INE (Guatemala)] republished in English at centralamericadata.com</ref>

INE publishes general agriculture, health, and environmental statistics.<ref>[https://knoema.com/atlas/sources/National-Institute-of-Statistics-Guatemala World Data Atlas, Sources: National Institute of Statistics, Guatemala] at knoema.com</ref>
